issue.description:
Found while root-causing a live NEEDLE dispatch bug on jedarden/tradegraph-
platform (see NEEDLE bead needle-34f83f6a for the full repro). bead-rs's
`bead list --json`/`bead show --json` dependency entries are the lean
`{"blocker": "<id>", "kind": "blocks"}` shape (no status/finished field on
the edge itself). A consumer that needs to know whether a dependency is
actually satisfied has to separately fetch every bead in the workspace and
build its own id -> finished lookup, then re-resolve every edge against it.
That reconstruction is exactly where NEEDLE's pluck strand appears to be
losing edges on a large graph (tradegraph-platform: 410 beads, 250+
dependency edges on its genesis bead) — plausibly a BeadId
normalization/equality mismatch between a bead's own `id` field and the
`id` parsed off a dependency edge (aliased from "blocker"), though that
part is still unconfirmed on the NEEDLE side.

Note this is a second, independent instance of the same shape gap already
flagged for src/profile/needle_v1.rs::native_to_profile(), which hardcodes
`"dependencies": []` with a comment that a full implementation would query
them (per 2026-08-12 gap analysis, memory: needle-bead-rs-compat-gap) — that
was about the interchange-profile path (`bead compare`/`migrate --to
needle-v1`); this bead is about the live `list --json`/`show --json` path
that NEEDLE's real dispatch loop actually uses day to day.

Proposal: enrich each dependency object in `list --json`/`show --json`
output with the blocker's resolved status at query time, e.g.
`{"blocker": "<id>", "kind": "blocks", "blocker_status": "closed"}` (or a
plain `"finished": true/false`). This is a compatible additive field --
existing consumers reading only `blocker`/`kind` are unaffected -- and it
removes an entire class of bug where a consumer's own reconstruction of
"is this blocker really done" can silently disagree with the store's own
answer, especially on deep/large dependency graphs where full-inventory
reconstruction is easy to get subtly wrong.

DoD: `list --json` and `show --json` dependency entries include a resolved
blocker-status (or equivalent finished boolean) field; existing tests for
the lean shape still pass (additive field only); needle_v1.rs profile
adapter can be updated to use the same resolved field instead of hardcoding
`[]`, though that specific wiring can be a separate bead.

[Re-created 2026-10-03 from beadrs-f8b3a085, which existed only in the codinghome live store that diverged from the committed checkpoint around 2026-09-05 and was displaced by 'bead restore' (commit ab8cca6). Backup: /home/coding/scratch/beadrs-beads-backup-20261003. Related untracked work in the shared checkout: tests/dependency_blocker_status.rs (2026-09-10) may belong to this bead.]
issue.notes: Implemented live JSON dependency status projection in src/main.rs. list --json and show --json now resolve each blocker through a LEFT JOIN and emit additive blocker_status plus finished fields; missing blockers are null/false. Added tests/dependency_status_projection.rs covering open and closed blockers across both commands. Commit: 3294f19. Verification: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test, and scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast all passed; the pre-existing untracked tests/dependency_blocker_status.rs was preserved and not staged.
issue.title: list/show --json dependency edges carry no resolved blocker status, forcing fragile consumer-side reconstruction

Gates, all run fresh: cargo test --test claim_epoch 9 passed / 0 failed, including a_claimed_issue_rejects_every_credentialless_claimant_mutation and an_unclaimed_issue_mutates_without_a_credential; cargo fmt --check exit 0; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings exit 0.

Mechanism, read from source: update_issue_in_tx runs validate_claimant_credential before any write, inside the mutation's own transaction; validate_claim_epoch_for_mutation (src/service/leases.rs:424) returns Error::LeaseConflict "Claim-epoch credential required" when no credential is presented against a live epoch, i.e. exit 4. enforce_claimant_credential (src/service/lifecycle.rs:92) early-returns Ok(()) when assignee is None, so unclaimed issues pass through.

The test pins the observable triple: exit code Some(4) AND stderr containing "Claim-epoch credential" (assert_credential_conflict), then a re-read asserting held_state (status/assignee/revision) and published_event_count are unchanged from the pre-sweep snapshot. The update leg is the first entry of claimant_mutations, so it is exercised on every sweep.

Also independently confirmed the 7addba8..HEAD diff touches only close_issue_in_tx / release_issue_impl / close_issue_impl and the held_state + published_event_count test helpers - not this slice - so the earlier "source-identical to 7addba8" claim was stale, and 89c7216 does not affect this arm.

No commit: verification-only, nothing to ship. Siblings own the stale-credential arm, the success path and the transaction invariant.
issue.description:
Child 1 of 4 in the auto-split of beadrs-9cdb17cf (itself child 1 of 5 under beadrs-a6554831). Covers ONLY the missing-credential arm of the update mutation.

Context: the fence this chain decomposes is believed already landed in commit 7addba8 on origin/main. The deliverable here is independent verification of this one slice against the landed commit, or the smallest fix if a gap is found. Re-implementing from scratch is not wanted, and siblings own the stale-credential arm, the success path, and the transaction invariant.

Scope:
- When an issue is claimed and update_issue / update_issue_in_tx (src/service/lifecycle.rs:142, :205) is invoked with NO claim-epoch credential, the mutation is refused with Error::LeaseConflict -> exit 4.
- The refusal changes nothing: no partial write, no revision bump, no published event; status and assignee remain exactly as the current claim left them.
- Unclaimed issues keep passing through (enforce_claimant_credential, lifecycle.rs:92, early-returns Ok when there is no assignee).

Acceptance:
- cargo test --test claim_epoch passes in the default suite, covering the update leg of the missing-credential case (a_claimed_issue_rejects_every_credentialless_claimant_mutation).
- The refusal is observable in the test: exit 4, a Claim-epoch credential message on stderr, and a re-read showing unchanged status, assignee, revision and published event count.
- cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean; no code change is expected for this slice.
issue.notes:
Fifth dispatch; independent re-verification 2026-09-05 at HEAD 89c7216, all gates run fresh this dispatch (not inherited from the fourth-dispatch note):

- cargo test --test claim_epoch: 9 passed, 0 failed, 5.41s. a_claimed_issue_rejects_every_credentialless_claimant_mutation ok; an_unclaimed_issue_mutates_without_a_credential ok.
- cargo fmt --check: exit 0. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings: exit 0.

Slice read from source at this HEAD:
- update_issue_in_tx calls validate_claimant_credential(tx, id, &issue, fencing_token, override_claim)? before the assignee/notes validation and before any write, inside the mutation's own transaction.
- src/service/leases.rs:424 - presented credential None with epoch > 0 yields Error::LeaseConflict("Claim-epoch credential required: ...") = exit 4.
- enforce_claimant_credential (src/service/lifecycle.rs:92) early-returns Ok(()) when assignee is None, so unclaimed issues pass through.
- The update leg is the first entry of claimant_mutations (tests/claim_epoch.rs:152, "update --notes probed" carrying no credential). assert_credential_conflict (line 127) requires exit code Some(4) AND stderr containing "Claim-epoch credential", so an unrelated failure cannot pass for a fence. After each refusal the test re-reads held_state (status/assignee/revision) and published_event_count and asserts both equal the pre-sweep snapshot (line 285).
- Independently confirmed the 7addba8..HEAD diff touches close_issue_in_tx / release_issue_impl / close_issue_impl in lifecycle.rs plus the held_state and published_event_count helpers and one test in claim_epoch.rs; none of validate_claimant_credential, enforce_claimant_credential, or update_issue_in_tx is touched, so this slice is unaffected by 89c7216.

Verdict: the missing-credential arm of the update path is correctly enforced by 7addba8 as landed at 89c7216. No gap, no code change. Stale-credential arm, success path and transaction invariant remain owned by siblings.

issue.description:
ADR-005 records the drawback that an operator legitimately parking work under an assignee will warn on every doctor run, teaching them to ignore the ready_frontier check. Add a hold/reservation marker settable through public CLI commands, preserved across reopen, rendered in list/show, and honored by doctor: a marked assignment stays excluded from the ready frontier but no longer triggers the ready_frontier warning. Requires schema and field-guide updates (stored vs derived semantics), an audit event, checkpoint round-trip coverage, and conformance tests. Nice-to-have follow-up that depends on the ADR-005 check landing first.

Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add a store-native intentional-hold marker for assignments so the ready_frontier warning stays meaningful
